ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:1 distribution of low-intensity black pixels concentrated in the central region and high-intensity white pixels concentrated on the lateral lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous black mass occupies the central 50% of the fluke surface, extending from the peduncle to the median notch. High-frequency mottling and isolated black pixel clusters are visible within the white fields of the distal lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 80-90 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous jagged boundary along the entire trailing edge with irregular pixel-amplitude peaks and valleys, most prominent on the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex lower margins that sweep upward and sharpen at the lateral distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular, high-intensity white pixel groupings located at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Visible dark, unaligned linear streaks cutting through the white pigmentation on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized biological colonization (barnacles) at both lobe tips and various small indentations/nicks along the trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinct 'island' pigmentation pattern where isolated black spots are surrounded by white pixels on the right lobe surface.
